title: Argentine Film ‘The River Train’ Wins Silver Peacock - Special Jury Award
subtitle: Jury applauds the film for pushing cinematic boundaries through refreshing experimentation and distinctive storytelling
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 8:20PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343222 Views: 75 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English Urdu Marathi हिन्दी Gujarati
Goa, 28 November 2026 The Argentine film The River Train , directed by Lorenzo Ferro and Lucas A. Vignale, has won the Silver Peacock Special Jury Award at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). The award was presented by Chief Minister of Goa, Shri Pramod Sawant, in the presence of Secretary, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Shri Chanchal Kumar, and Festival Director Shri Ashutosh Gowarikar. Recognising the film’s distinctive cinematic expression, the jury applauded its experimental approach to storytelling and its ability to explore the possibilities of cinema through a child’s perspective. The citation noted the directors’ willingness to push conventional cinematic boundaries, stating: “For transforming cinema into a playground through a child's eyes and pushing cinematic boundaries with refreshing experimentation. We honour the visionary spirit of both directors and the memory of Lucas A. Vignale.” The award was received by producer Valentine Torre and actor Rita Pauls on behalf of the directors. The ceremony also paid tribute to co-director Lucas A. Vignale, acknowledging his creative contribution to the film. The Special Jury Award recognises a film in the Main International Competition for its artistic achievement and distinctive cinematic expression. It comprises the Silver Peacock, a certificate and a cash prize of ₹20 lakh. Synopsis of The River Train Nine-year-old Milo lives in a remote village in Argentina, where he trains as a Malambo dancer. But his dreams lie elsewhere. He longs to ride trains and explore Buenos Aires, a city he has only seen in films. To break free from his small world, he must dare to embark on a new journey: one marked by loneliness.
